rationale: Started 2026-11-10T08:19:02Z; ended 2026-11-10T08:34:20Z (UTC). I did not produce this decision. Every source_fingerprints file re-hashed to its pinned digest, each checked record's text_path re-hashed to its text_sha256, and each quoted text equals the exact char_start:char_end slice of its held file. I read the original in full (51 FR 43721): EO 12576 of Dec. 2, 1986 delegates the President's functions under sections 803 (5 U.S.C. 5569) and 806 (37 U.S.C. 559) of Pub. L. 99-399 to the Secretaries of State and Defense for captives held on or before Jan. 21, 1981, with a consultation duty; identity is confirmed and it has no term. The held FR text of EO 12598 (52 FR 23421, June 17, 1987) re-delegates the same section 803(a) and 806(a) functions without that date limit, repeats the consultation duty and says in Sec. 6 that Executive Order No. 12576 of December 2, 1986 is hereby superseded; it has no deferred effective date, so the supersession reaches all three sections from 1987-06-17. Cruden found only EO 12598 texts naming EO 12576 and no earlier end, so status no holds.
